title: The Energy Vault is a Dumb Idea, Here's Why
summary: Adam Something argues in four minutes that gravity batteries like Energy Vault, which lift concrete blocks with cranes, are a poor energy storage idea. He draws on a longer Thunderf00t debunk.
why: HN cites it as the go-to debunk when gravity storage projects appear, usually by commenters who think the idea is a dud.

quote.text: This is a stupid idea, and there are some great YouTube videos that explain why[1].
